newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: VEBA not aiming at new activity -chairman.
newsitem.headline: VEBA not aiming at new activity -chairman.

text.p: German utility VEBA AG does not want to branch out into new businsses as it pursues its goal of aggressive foreign expansion, Chairman Ulrich Hartmann said.
"Naturally we will do this on the basis of our existing business. We are not seeking completely new activities," he told reporters at the International Management Symposium.

Hartmann has said VEBA wants to have half its turnover from abroad in the year 2005. That would represent 50 billion to 60 billion in foreign sales, up from 25 billion now. "This is a demanding target for us," he said.
Foreign sales now account for 30 percent of turnover now, he said.
He said the most promising growth in the chemicals sector included wafer production and phenol. In the trade and services areas, he cited electronics trading and energy services.
